summary: Hantai Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. is a distributor of high-quality engineering materials and patented specialty chemical formulations, focusing on applications in the semiconductor, optoelectronics, and biotechnology industries. The company collaborates with its parent company, Shin-Hong Technology, to provide advanced materials and solutions that enhance process reliability and stability.
